svg.text: Edge shooting (α = 0): converged profiles on the adaptive RKF45 mesh, and the step sizes
semi-infinite gap, case 1, b = 0.25: 1339 shots, 2661 steps
step refinement where the solution varies fast
third gap, b = −1.207 (x₀ = π/2): 1219 shots, 5284 steps
step refinement where the solution varies fast
Integration runs from ξ_f (right) to 0 starting on the decaying Floquet manifold (+ forced SH tail); rtol = 1e-12. The thesis flowchart (nested bracket + bisection) sets the two tail amplitudes.
